_note: An empty string 'value'. An empty string must not become the stop ID -- get_settings must treat it the same as missing and fall back to DEFAULT_STOP_ID. This is the one config-* case where a plausible bug (dropping the 'and value' truthiness guard) does NOT crash: stop_id becomes '', the fetch URL collapses to exactly the /stops/ LISTING endpoint (not the per-stop one), and both directions silently degrade to 'no trains' -- a real, user-visible regression the divider-only check can't see. assert_matches_stop (a config-independent oracle, see gate.py) requires the real G35 trip content, which a silent 'no trains' degrade fails to reproduce.
